name: angrywrk
label: Last time R felt really angry

questions.text:
Within the past month, think about the last time you felt really angry, irritated or annoyed. Could you describe in a couple of sentences what made you feel that way -- what the situation was? (INTERVIEWER: IF RESPONDENT CANNOT RECOVER AN EVENT, PROBE WITH "You haven't felt irritated or annoyed in the past month?")
